DayIn.title: DayIn
DayIn.description:
One OPEN day, as the form sends it. A closed day is sent as null instead.

mode="before": our validator sees the raw JSON value first, so every bad input (text,
a number, null) gets our own message, and the field then really holds a `time`.
default=None + validate_default=True: an empty box (or a missing key) reaches it too.

ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope
ErrorEnvelope.description: The error response shape, for the OpenAPI schema (so the frontend types know it).

InviteCreated.title: InviteCreated
InviteCreated.description: The raw token, shown ONCE. The database keeps only its hash.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description:
What the app needs to know about the logged-in User: their Roles, and what they may do.

The app shows or hides nav items and pages from `permissions` (UX-DR27). It never
works the rules out itself: the FR-10 table lives only in the backend (AD-5).

MemberUpdate.title: MemberUpdate
MemberUpdate.description: A change to one member. Leave a field out (or null) to keep it as it is.

MessageOut.title: MessageOut
MessageOut.description: One Message as the Chat Page sees it. No ids except the browser's own client_message_id.

OpenHours.title: OpenHours
OpenHours.description: The hours of one open day. Both times are always there.

Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description:
One member per row of the FR-10 table. permissions.py says which Roles may do each.

A later action with no FR-10 row (e.g. delete a Customer) adds its own member.

ServiceIn.title: ServiceIn
ServiceIn.description:
A whole Service, for add (POST) and replace (PUT). Every field must be sent.

One schema for both, so "save" and "activate" pass the same rules (FR-12:
a Service cannot be saved OR activated without a Price).

SetupOut.title: SetupOut
SetupOut.description: What the Owner's Dashboard checklist needs: the chat link and what is still missing.

Theme.title: Theme
Theme.description: The look a User picked. "system" follows their device.

ThemeUpdate.title: ThemeUpdate
ThemeUpdate.description: The body of PUT /me/theme: the look the User picked.

WeekIn.title: WeekIn
WeekIn.description: The whole week, for a full replace (PUT). Every day must be sent; null = closed.
